job.title: Senior Commercial Finance Analyst
job.description:
Senior Commercial Finance Analyst

Leeds | Circa £45,000 – up to £50,000 DOE | Hybrid – 3 days office / 2 days home

I'm working with a large international professional services organisation to recruit a Senior Commercial Finance Analyst into its established finance team in Leeds.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys the analytical and commercial side of finance – working with data, understanding what the numbers are telling you and then being able to communicate that clearly and confidently to stakeholders across the business.

This is a busy, fast-paced environment with high expectations, so we're looking for someone who can take ownership of their work, manage competing demands and hold their own when working with senior stakeholders.

You don't necessarily need to be fully qualified. You may be part-qualified ACCA/CIMA, approaching qualification, or have developed strong commercial finance experience without following the professional qualification route.

What you will need is exceptional Excel. This is a role for someone who genuinely enjoys working with spreadsheets and large volumes of complex financial data. You'll be highly confident with PivotTables, VLOOKUPs/XLOOKUPs, complex formulas and manipulating, validating and analysing data. Power BI experience would be a definite advantage as you will work with this regularly.

The role

Working as part of a sizeable commercial finance function, you'll:

  • Analyse financial and commercial performance, including P&L and key performance indicators (KPIs)

  • Produce regular reporting, commentary and variance analysis, identifying trends and areas requiring further investigation

  • Work extensively with Excel and large datasets to interrogate, validate and interpret financial information

  • Take ownership of weekly and monthly reporting, ensuring accuracy and delivery to agreed deadlines

  • Turn financial information into clear, useful commercial insight

  • Support stakeholders in understanding performance and the key drivers behind the numbers

  • Present financial information and confidently explain findings to both finance and non-finance colleagues

  • Provide analysis to support commercial and business decision-making

  • Work with stakeholders across different areas and international locations

  • Manage a demanding workload where priorities can change quickly

  • Build strong relationships with colleagues and stakeholders, responding confidently to requests and challenges

  • Contribute to improving reporting, processes and the way financial information is used across the business

What we're looking for

You'll ideally have:

  • Previous experience within commercial finance, management accounting, financial analysis or a similar analytical finance role

  • A good understanding of P&L, KPIs and commercial performance

  • Exceptional Excel skills – this is absolutely essential

  • Strong analytical ability and confidence working independently with significant volumes of complex data

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to explain and discuss financial information with senior stakeholders

  • The ability to take ownership of responsibilities and work effectively with a manager who is based in another office

  • A proactive, responsive and organised approach to a demanding workload

  • Experience working in a busy, commercially focused environment with competing stakeholder demands

  • Power BI experience would be highly desirable

  • SAP experience would be advantageous

Experience within a law firm would be particularly attractive, although candidates from other professional services organisations will also be very welcome.

We're particularly interested in individuals who are progressing in their commercial finance careers and are looking for an opportunity to take on greater responsibility and develop their business partnering skills.

You could be part-qualified ACCA/CIMA, fully qualified, or qualified by experience with a strong track record in relevant finance roles.

What's on offer?

This is a high-expectation environment, but one where people are supported, developed and recognised for doing a good job. There is genuine opportunity to progress as you develop within the team.

The role is Monday to Friday, 9am–5pm (35 hours per week), with a hybrid working pattern of three days in the Leeds office and two days from home.

The ideal salary is around £45,000, although there is flexibility up to £50,000 for an exceptional candidate who can demonstrate the technical expertise, commercial experience and stakeholder management skills required. The package also includes benefits and the potential for a discretionary bonus.

If you enjoy finance but particularly love the commercial analysis, P&L, KPI, data and Excel side of your role, I'd be very interested in speaking with you.

Location: Leeds city centre

Job Type: Permanent, Full Time

job.title: Group Finance Manager
job.description:
Group Finance Manager – Morley, Leeds

Salary: Up to £67,500 depending on experience + car allowance/company car + bonus

I'm working with an established and successful, privately owned housebuilding business to recruit an experienced Group Finance Manager. This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded finance professional who enjoys taking ownership, working closely with senior management and playing an important role in the financial performance of a business.

The company operates across two regions and is looking for someone who can combine strong financial management skills with commercial awareness, leadership and a proactive, hands-on approach.

This is a key appointment within the senior finance team, offering genuine responsibility, autonomy and the opportunity to influence financial performance and decision-making across the business.

The Role

Reporting directly to the Finance Director and managing a small finance team, you'll take responsibility for overseeing financial reporting, cash flow and financial planning across two regional operations.

Key responsibilities will include:

  • Overseeing the preparation of monthly management accounts, including profit and loss, balance sheet reporting and financial controls.

  • Managing cash flow forecasting, budgeting and financial planning across both regions.

  • Monitoring site and project performance, including valuations, work in progress and cost-to-complete forecasts.

  • Working closely with regional directors and operational teams to provide financial insight and support commercial decisions.

  • Reviewing financial performance against budgets and forecasts, identifying risks and challenging assumptions.

  • Leading, supporting and developing members of the finance team.

  • Supporting statutory reporting, year-end accounts, audit and financial compliance.

  • Ensuring consistency in financial reporting and processes across both regions.

  • Identifying opportunities to improve financial systems, reporting and operational efficiency.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a qualified accountant with strong financial management experience, ideally gained within housebuilding, construction or a similar project-based business.

Ideally, you'll bring:

  • ACCA or CIMA qualification.

  • Strong experience in management accounts, budgeting, forecasting and cash flow management.

  • Experience within housebuilding or construction would be a significant advantage.

  • A good understanding of project accounting, including work in progress, site valuations and cost-to-complete reporting.

  • Strong commercial awareness and the ability to interpret financial information to support business decisions.

  • Confidence working with senior management and challenging financial and operational performance.

  • Previous experience managing, supporting and developing finance teams.

  • Excellent communication, organisational and analytical skills.

  • A proactive, confident approach with the ability to take ownership and work across multiple business areas.

Experience of COINS accounting software would be advantageous, although training will be provided.

Applications are welcomed from experienced Finance Managers as well as strong Financial Controllers who are ready to take the next step in their careers.

Above all, we're looking for someone commercially aware, confident and approachable, who can build strong working relationships and manage the financial demands of a busy, multi-site business.

What's on Offer?

  • Salary up to £67,500 depending on experience.

  • £6,000 annual car allowance or company car.

  • Bonus scheme of up to 20%.

  • 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays.

  • Option to purchase up to five additional days' annual leave.

  • 5% pension.

  • Life assurance at twice annual salary.

  • Access to an employee assistance programme.

  • Salary sacrifice pension option.

  • A senior, influential position within an established, privately owned business.

  • The opportunity to work closely with the Finance Director and senior operational management.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to take the next step in their finance career, with responsibility across two regions and the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to the business.

Location: Morley, Leeds (office-based, with occasional regional travel)

Job Type: Permanent, Full-time

If this sounds like the right next step for you, please get in touch for a confidential conversation.

Due to the volume of applications, we may not be able to respond to every applicant. If you haven't heard from us within seven days, please assume that your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion.

job.title: Semi Senior Accountant
job.description:
Accounts Semi-Senior – Harrogate

Salary: £32,000–£37,500 depending on experience

I'm working with an established and growing accountancy group in Harrogate to recruit an Accounts Semi-Senior into its team.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working in accountancy practice, particularly accounts preparation, and is looking for a business where they can continue developing their skills and progressing their career.

Ideally, we're looking for someone already operating at Semi-Senior level, with good practical accounts preparation experience. However, there is flexibility around the level of appointment. We'd also be interested in speaking with someone slightly more junior who is ready to take the next step, or an experienced Semi-Senior who feels ready to progress towards Senior level. Salary would reflect the successful candidate's experience and the level of responsibility they can undertake.

What is particularly important to this business is finding someone who is driven, enthusiastic and genuinely wants to progress. They want someone with a strong work ethic, who takes pride in their work, embraces new challenges and is keen to develop within a growing organisation.

Experience with IRIS and Xero would be beneficial. Neither is essential for someone with the right background and attitude.

The role

Working alongside an experienced team of accountants, you'll:

  • Prepare year-end accounts for limited companies, partnerships and sole traders
  • Assist with the preparation of company financial statements
  • Prepare interim management accounts
  • Undertake client bookkeeping and maintain accurate accounting records
  • Prepare quarterly VAT returns and support Making Tax Digital requirements
  • Assist with the management of a portfolio of clients
  • Prepare draft tax computations for manager review, where appropriate
  • Liaise with clients to obtain information and resolve queries
  • Support senior colleagues with accounts preparation and other client requirements
  • Assist with company secretarial duties where required
  • Support the training and development of apprentices where appropriate
  • Undertake general accountancy duties as required

The emphasis of this opportunity is accounts preparation rather than tax, although there will be some exposure to associated tax work.

What we're looking for

You'll ideally have:

  • A minimum of 2–3 years' experience within a UK accountancy practice, ideally working at Semi-Senior level for the advertised salary range of £35,000–£38,000.
  • Practical experience preparing accounts for a variety of clients
  • An understanding of VAT returns and associated accounting requirements
  • Good organisational skills and excellent attention to detail
  • The ability to manage your workload and meet deadlines
  • Strong communication skills and a professional approach to clients
  • A proactive attitude and willingness to take on additional responsibility
  • A genuine interest in developing your technical skills and progressing your career
  • Experience with Xero, IRIS, MyWorkpapers, Sage or QuickBooks would be advantageous

You may be studying towards AAT, ACA or ACCA, or have gained relevant experience through working in practice.

Above all, we're looking for someone who is ambitious, hardworking and determined to succeed.

You'll enjoy being part of a busy team, be adaptable to change and have the motivation to develop within a growing organisation.

What's on offer?

This is an opportunity to join an expanding accountancy group where career development is encouraged and strong performance is recognised.

The business offers ongoing training and development, study support where applicable and opportunities to progress as your experience grows.

Benefits include:

  • 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays
  • Company pension scheme
  • Health cash plan
  • Life assurance
  • Payment of relevant professional memberships
  • Study support where applicable
  • Additional employee benefits and social events

The role is Monday to Friday, 37.5 hours per week, with hybrid working available following successful completion of probation, allowing three days in the Harrogate office and two days working from home.

Salary is £32,000–£37,500 depending on experience. The business is flexible around the level of appointment and would consider someone slightly more junior, with salary reflecting their experience, or an established Semi-Senior who is ready to take the next step towards a Senior position.

If you're working in accountancy practice and feel ready to develop your career within a growing business, I'd be very interested in speaking with you.

job.title: Operations Manager
job.description:
Great service takes strong leadership, clear processes and the determination to keep making things better. If you’re an Operations Manager who knows how to develop people, improve performance and see problems through to resolution, this could be your next move.

 

Our priority is finding an experienced operational leader with the curiosity to learn, the confidence to take ownership and the tenacity to turn improvement plans into lasting results.

 

The opportunity

You will be managing a team of 6 IT support professionals, bringing structure, direction and a customer focus, you’ll help those teams deliver a reliable, responsive service across the group.

 

Your expertise will be in getting the best from people and processes: setting clear expectations, understanding what the data tells you, removing obstacles and following through. You’ll work closely with technical specialists, business leaders and suppliers to make that happen, IT knowledge is not essential but the willingness to learn is.

 

Where you’ll make a difference

  • Lead and develop your people. Coach team members, hold meaningful one-to-ones, tackle performance issues and build a culture of accountability and support.
  • Make operations run better. Simplify processes, strengthen handovers, reduce recurring problems and identify opportunities to automate repetitive work.
  • Turn insight into action. Use performance measures, customer feedback and service trends to identify what needs attention and track whether changes are working.
  • Take ownership when it matters. Bring calm, coordination and clear communication when services are disrupted, keeping people focused until the issue is resolved.
  • Build productive relationships. Understand what the business needs, manage expectations and hold suppliers to their commitments.
  • Keep standards high. Ensure processes are documented, followed and continually improved, supporting a secure, resilient service in a regulated environment.

 

What you’ll bring

We’re particularly interested in your experience of leading operations, improving services and managing people, ideally within a regulated professional services environment.

 

You’ll bring:

  • A track record of leading teams and helping people perform at their best.
  • Examples of process improvements that delivered measurable results.
  • Confidence managing targets, service standards and competing priorities.
  • Tenacity: you ask questions, get to the root of problems and stay with them until the solution sticks.
  • Sound judgement and a calm, practical approach under pressure.
  • Clear communication and the ability to build trust with colleagues, leaders and suppliers.
  • A customer focus and the willingness to challenge ways of working that could be better.

 

Success will mean stronger teams, smoother processes, fewer recurring issues and colleagues who feel well supported. You’ll be able to see the difference your leadership makes through improved service performance, customer satisfaction and operational resilience.

 

What's in it for you:

  • Salary up to £50k depending on experience
  • Hybrid working
  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
  • Great culture 
  • Matched pension scheme
  • Private health insurance
  • Salary sacrifice scheme
  • Smart-casual dress code
  • In-house training and career development opportunities
  • Regular charity and social events

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking for a varied, customer-focused position within a growing organisation

job.title: Customer Service Administrator
job.description:

This is a varied customer service role supporting customers with vehicle and small electrical equipment breakdowns. You will be responsible for taking incoming breakdown calls, understanding the issue and coordinating with suppliers and engineers to get customers back up and running as quickly as possible.

You'll work independently while also liaising closely with your immediate team, third-party suppliers and other departments across the company.

Responsibilities

  • Liaise with suppliers and engineering support to arrange repairs and assistance
  • Keep customers regularly updated by phone and email on the progress of their vehicle or equipment repair
  • Ensure downtime is kept to an absolute minimum and escalate issues where necessary
  • Liaise with other departments to raise purchase orders and recharges
  • Work with the accounts team to resolve billing queries
  • Work closely with finance, workshop and sales teams
  • Maintain accurate and detailed customer and breakdown records
  • Deliver a professional, friendly and courteous service at all times

What we're looking for

  • Previous customer service experience
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Well organised with good planning and prioritisation skills
  • Confident using Microsoft Office
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • A natural problem-solver
  • Ability to remain calm and make decisions under pressure
  • Comfortable working to tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment
